captures.capture_subject: Main Title Screen & Campaign Entry UI
captures.visual_observations: Authentic 1280x720 windowed UI rendering. Shows 'PROJECT KNIGHT: THE CHOSEN ONE' title logo, version v1.2.0, and 3 mode selection cards ('DEPLOY 3D QV', 'CLASSIC 2D RUN', 'AX-PROTOTYPE'). Background features volumetric fog and cyan rim lighting.

Stage 1 '성문 외곽' (Citadel Terrace Gate) first rendered frame at X=-8.0. Shows 3D flagstone floor, distant castle backdrop, top-left tactical unit plate ('SSR Paladin' with soul gems), and progress bar. Critical defect observed: NO on-screen virtual joystick or touch buttons instantiated (ISSUE-V3-001-01).

Player running rightward along X-axis at ~7.5 m/s. 2D Paladin Sprite3D faces direction of motion. Real-time directional cast shadow grounds the character onto the 3D flagstone floor with authentic shadow perspective.

Player moved forward to Z=+4.0 along front curb boundary. Illustrates the 2.5D belt-scrolling movement model. Demonstrates visual depth variation and potential for melee hitbox misalignment against enemies at different Z coordinates (ISSUE-V3-001-02).

Player executing Space jump at peak trajectory (~3.2m above floor). Cast shadow accurately tracks vertically below the character on the 3D floor geometry. Noticeable slight tilt in billboard orientation relative to the -32 degree camera pitch (ISSUE-V3-001-04).

Player executing Combo Hit 3. Glowing cyan spear thrust slash arc ('SlashVisual3D') rendered with additive blending. Spark particles and screen shake trauma observed. Top-right combo chain HUD increments.

Player activating Guard Barrier ('GuardBarrier3D'). Cyan glowing runic shield torus surrounds the Paladin sprite with high-intensity emission. Dash motion blur streak confirms responsive evasive state.

Player engaging two Wave 1 melee minions at X=2.0 and X=4.0. Minions display red silhouette hurtbox frames upon taking damage. Red float text popup visible. Background elements maintain high contrast against combat foreground.
Boss Commander spawns at X > 8.0 with 24 HP winged boss health bar at screen top. Boss displays crimson aura and charging windup pose. Ground runic seal glows intensely with 2.4x bloom.

captures.capture_subject: Active Boss Combat & Foreground Occlusion Defect
captures.visual_observations: Active combat against Boss Commander in the far-right terrace zone. CRITICAL DEFECT OBSERVED: Massive 3D foreground stone wall and pillar structure on the camera plane completely occludes 35-40% of the screen center-right, hiding the player sprite and boss during active melee exchange (ISSUE-V3-001-07).

Boss Commander defeated (HP reduced to 0). Gold 'STAGE 1 CLEARED' victory banner pulses across viewport center. Camera trauma smoothly decays. Demonstrates absence of rich victory/rewards modal before campaign progression (ISSUE-V3-001-06).
